name: CID Tuning Dataset Builder
description: Build a stratified tuning CSV from a raw gold file into tests/<agent_id>/.

format.description: CSV row format: re | ner | pubtator, default re.

source.description: Raw gold source path, default data/raw/dev.txt.

write_test_remain.description: Also write remaining docs as test CSV, default true.

mirror_agent_id.description: Optional second agent folder to mirror outputs.

mirror_format.description: Format for mirror output, default ner.
